
```{r}
library(rrrSingleCellUtils)
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(future)
library(future.apply)
if(Sys.info()['sysname'] == "Windows") {
  plan(multisession, workers = 5)
} else {
  plan(multicore)
}
options(future.globals.maxSize = 10000 * 1024^2)
```


```{r}
pre_path <- "~/../lab/Counts_2/"
# pre_path <- "C:/Users/rxr014/OneDrive - Nationwide Children's Hospital/BIScratch/"
post_path <- "/filtered_feature_bc_matrix"
samples <- tribble(
  ~id, ~model, ~mt_cutoff, ~count_cutoff, ~species,
  "S0058", "Patient", 25, 160000, "",
  "S0059", "Patient", 25, 160000, "",
  "S0217", "Patient", 25, 160000, "",
  "S0218", "Patient", 25, 160000, "",
  "S0262", "Patient", 25, 160000, "",
  "S0264", "Patient", 25, 160000, ""
)

human_mets <- future_lapply(seq_along(samples$id), function(s) {
  o <- tenx_load_qc(
    paste0(pre_path, samples$id[s], post_path),
    species_pattern = samples$species[s],
    violin_plot = FALSE
  ) %>%
  subset(
    percent.mt < samples$mt_cutoff[s] &
    nCount_RNA < samples$count_cutoff[s]
  ) %>%
  NormalizeData()

  o$id <- samples$id[s]
  o$model <- samples$model[s]

  return(o)
})

human_mets <- merge(human_mets[[1]], human_mets[2:length(samples$id)],
  add.cell.ids = samples$id) %>%
  JoinLayers()

human_mets <- human_mets %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 5000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  harmony::RunHarmony(group.by.vars = "id")

human_mets <- human_mets %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony", k.param = 40L) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

r_dim_plot(human_mets) +
  labs(title = "Human Lung Mets")
r_dim_plot(human_mets, group.by = "id")
r_feature_plot(human_mets, "COL1A1")

human_mets <- kill_cc(human_mets)
Idents(human_mets) <- human_mets$seurat_clusters
```

## Isolate tumor cells
```{r}
met_tumor <- subset(human_mets, idents = c(1, 3, 5))

met_tumor <- met_tumor %>%
  FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 5000) %>%
  ScaleData() %>%
  RunPCA() %>%
  harmony::RunHarmony(group.by.vars = "id") %>%
  FindNeighbors(reduction = "harmony", k.param = 40L) %>%
  FindClusters(resolution = 0.2) %>%
  RunUMAP(reduction = "harmony", dims = 1:30)

r_dim_plot(met_tumor)

met_tumor <- kill_cc(met_tumor)
met_tumor <- run_fdl(met_tumor)

r_dim_plot(met_tumor, reduction = "fdl", group.by = "seurat_clusters") +
  labs(title = "Metastasis tumor cells")

r_dim_plot(met_tumor,
    reduction = "fdl",
    group.by = "Phase",
    label = FALSE) +
  labs(title = "Human Metastases - Cell Cycle") +
  theme(legend.position = "right")

r_feature_plot(met_tumor, "IL6", reduction = "fdl")
```

# Investigate whether there is a subset of cells with activation of NF-kB
```{r}
sigs <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens",
    category = "H") %>%
  select(gs_name, gene_symbol)

gs <- "HALLMARK_TNFA_SIGNALING_VIA_NFKB"

cell_ranks <- AUCell::AUCell_run(
  met_tumor[["RNA"]]$counts,
  sigs %>% filter(gs_name == gs) %>% pull(gene_symbol)
)

met_tumor$nfkb_activity <- AUCell::getAUC(cell_ranks)[1, ]

FeaturePlot(met_tumor,
  "nfkb_activity",
  reduction = "fdl",
  cols = c("#EEEEEE", "#ae0600"),
  min.cutoff = 0.15,
  pt.size = 1,
  order = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed()

FeaturePlot(met_tumor,
  "IL1R1",
  reduction = "fdl",
  cols = c("#EEEEEE", "#ae0600"),
  min.cutoff = 1,
  pt.size = 1,
  order = TRUE) +
  coord_fixed()
```
